rationale: B wins because it found the sharper commercial pressure point: "Replit charges by usage for an agent it won't say how often gets the app right," then separated that from a real reviewer/data angle, "Here is how many ran without a fix." A is cleaner, but it throws away the pricing story as "no_journalist_shape" when usage billing plus undisclosed reliability is exactly the hook. B still needs a slap for overclaiming "tens of millions of hobbyists," but its best angles are better strategic material for press.
gaps_in_A: "Pricing model analysis (usage-based on top of subscriptions) — `no_journalist_shape`" is too timid. The usage billing model becomes a real story when paired with undisclosed reliability.

"AI Tools Have Crossed From Code Autocomplete to Full-Stack App Delivery" is the weakest kept angle: broad category thesis, one company launch, and it admits it needs comparables before it is actually a trend.
"Replit contradicting its own founding premise" overstates the supplied facts. The update says Replit is used heavily in education, not that education is its founding premise.
"It Won't Say How Often They Actually Work" edges from nondisclosure into refusal. That is pitchable only with a company no-comment, test result, or user evidence.
gaps_in_B: "the same product will land in the accounts schools already use" is not in the update. The set later asks whether education accounts can use it, which proves the earlier line was too confident.

"tens of millions of hobbyists would rather describe an app than code one" invents both the hobbyist composition and the preference. The facts only say Replit claims tens of millions of users and is targeting non-engineers/vibe coders.
"Story type: defensive-comment" is the wrong label for a kept story angle. The underlying pricing/reliability angle works, but the tag sounds like comms triage, not a reporter-facing story shape.
The set has two reliability-derived angles, pricing and benchmark. They are distinct, but pitching both without fresh proof would make the package feel padded around the same missing number.
